OPEN (Energize B): Pilot valve shifts main spool, directing pump flow from P to port B, while port A returns flow to tank.

flow_scenarios: Neutral: Main spool in center position; P, A, and B ports are connected to Tank (open neutral).
Actuation A: Spool shifts to parallel envelope; flow travels from main P line to Port A (top and bottom), return flow from Port B goes to Tank.
Actuation B: Spool shifts to crossed envelope; flow travels from main P line to Port B (top and bottom), return flow from Port A goes to Tank.
Shock/Suction B: If pressure on Port B line exceeds 260 bar, the shock valve opens to vent excess pressure to the Tank line.
Bottom Port A Holding: When EV-10.6 solenoid is de-energized, the 2-way valve blocks flow to/from bottom Port A 1/4"G.
Bottom Port A Relief: If pressure at the blocked bottom Port A 1/4"G exceeds 225 bar, the relief valve opens to vent pressure back to the spool line.
